about.description: Manages IPv4 configurations for network adapters: save profiles, assign them and apply them with one click – with a backup before every change and automatic restore on errors.
about.rightsUser: Running with standard rights; administrator rights are requested only when changing settings.
adminAutostart.confirm:
From now on, IP-Switch will be started at sign-in through a scheduled task with administrator rights. Profiles are then applied without a UAC prompt.

Please note: the application will then run permanently with elevated rights.
